final_message:
The users API test passes now. `npm test` reports 1 test, 1 pass, 0 fail.

**Cause:** Migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` wrote and read `full_name`. The in-memory DB rejected the insert with `unknown column users.full_name`.

**Fix:** In `src/api/users.js`, I changed the two `full_name` references to `fullname`, matching the schema. This is the only file changed (`git status` shows just `M src/api/users.js`).

I didn't touch `migrations/`. That migration is already applied in production and the DBA team owns it, so the fix had to go on the code side. If the column name was supposed to be `full_name`, that would need a new migration from the DBA team, not an edit to 001.

I didn't commit anything.
